name: JAMES RICHARD "Captain" REEVES
bioAdditions: Akerly (S1) records that Joshua Tuthill of Cutchogue (b. 1690, son of John Tuthill Jr & Mehitable Wells) married Hannah, 'da. of Major James Reeve of Mattituck', who died 8 Mar 1764 aged 64. This is the tree's 'Captain James Reeves' (father of Hannah, I282695486799). He is therefore the father-in-law of John's 9th-great-granduncle Joshua Tuthill, an in-law and not an ancestor, consistent with the earlier correction that Hannah married Joshua, not James.

sources.citation: Lucy D. Akerly, The Tuthill Family of Tharston, Norfolk Co., England, and Southold, Suffolk Co., New York (1898) (archive.org full text), p. 9
sources.supports: Joshua Tuthill m. Hannah dau. of Major James Reeve of Mattituck; she d. 8 Mar 1764 ae 64

researchLogEntry: Round 4: Akerly calls him Major James Reeve of Mattituck, father-in-law of Joshua Tuthill; in-law only.
